ExtraBar 1.2.7 – Welcome Aboard! 🎓✨

✨ What's New

  • Interactive Onboarding: New users get a guided walkthrough that sets up their bar with real apps, live customization, and pre-built actions – the best first impression yet!
  • Smart App Detection: Onboarding detects installed apps like Raycast, Figma, Cursor, VS Code, Bear, Bloom, and CleanShot X and offers to configure them automatically – your bar is ready in seconds!

⚡ Improvements

  • Widget Custom Icon Overrides: Widgets now support custom icon overrides in both floating bar and menu bar modes – full flexibility!
  • Crisp SF Symbols: SF Symbols in the floating bar render at proper sizes – no more clipping on tall symbols!
  • Scalable Folder Icons: Widget folder menu icons now scale with your bar size setting!
  • Safe Deletions: Deleting a preset or removing a menu action now requires confirmation. Active presets can't be deleted until you switch away!
  • App Row Context Menu: Each app row now has a "..." menu with Move/Copy, Change Icon, and Remove – replacing the old delete button!
  • Preset Row Context Menu: Preset rows now have a "..." menu with Rename, Duplicate, and Delete!
  • Better Floating Bar Icons: Icons now resize correctly according to your Bar Size in Floating Bar mode – no more tiny, hard-to-read menus!

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Floating Bar Menus: Fixed menus misbehaving when clicking on apps in Floating Bar mode!
  • Deep Link Screen Fix: Fixed the deep link action screen freezing the app when closed via the window's close button!
  • Consistent Widget Icons: Fixed widget icons rendering inconsistently across display modes!
  • Tahoe Tray Fix: Removed a checkmark incorrectly appearing next to Quit in the system tray on macOS Tahoe!

🏷️ Renamed

  • "Select" → "Move/Copy": Clearer about what multi-select does – no more guessing!

🚀 What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make – keep it coming! 💙
